description: Use this when the couple asks about the state of their own orders. The signed-in couple's own orders on Zola, newest first: paper orders (invitations, save-the-dates, cards) with their production stage, shop orders, and the items that the couple bought from their own registry. Gives the order number, date, total, and for each group of items the status, carrier, tracking link, and estimated arrival. Does not give the gifts that guests sent: use zola_get_my_gift_tracker. No address or payment details. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read). Do not use for how orders, shipping or returns work on Zola in general: use zola_search_help_articles.

limit.description: The most orders to give, 1 to 25. The default is 10.

query.description: A part of the product or brand name, for example "invitation". Leave it out for every order.

name: zola_list_my_orders

outputSchema.description: The orders that the signed-in user placed on Zola

exists.description: Always true: the orders belong to the user. total_orders 0 means no orders

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

matched.description: The orders that match the query, before the limit

orders.description: Newest order first. No address, payment, or gift message

order_number.description: The order number that Zola customer support asks for

arrives_from.description: The first day of the estimated arrival, YYYY-MM-DD

arrives_to.description: The last day of the estimated arrival, YYYY-MM-DD

kind.description: paper: invitations, cards, and other printed items. digital: digital cards and website upgrades. product: shop and registry items

status.description: The state of this group of items. For a paper order, the production stage. Null for an item bought in another store

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the list

title: List My Zola Orders
